dedupe_keys.name: flood modeller jacobs commercial 1d 2d hydraulic and hydrological flood modelling software

description: Flood Modeller is commercial flood modelling software developed by Jacobs, which says it has been a leader in flood modelling software for 50 years. It combines model building, hydrological analysis and hydraulic solvers for all sources of flooding in one GIS-based environment for integrated catchment modelling. Coverage: a general modelling tool used worldwide, with UK, USA and Australian site editions; the site lists model build, hydraulic and hydrological analysis, visualisation and reporting, a GPU solver, a damage calculator, a +Hydrology module, and integrations with WINFAP and ReFH2 (UK flood hydrology), TUFLOW, the Flood Platform, Delft-FEWS, EPA SWMM and Fathom data. Format and access: Windows software with Lite, Standard and Professional subscription editions that include a multi-user network licence, support and updates; a free trial; Standard edition at no cost to students and lecturers for education and research; and an open-source Python API (floodmodeller-api on PyPI and GitHub) with classes for model files such as DAT, IED, IEF and ZZN results. Licence: proprietary software licence; the Python API is GPL-3.0-or-later. Caveats: most feature pages render by script and only the home, pricing, academic and Python API pages were read, so solver methods are not described here from source. Simulation uses: modelling flooding from all sources for hazard exposure, flood defence capacity planning and climate adaptation of infrastructure. Related records: TUFLOW (model-tuflow-hydraulic-modelling-suite), HEC-RAS (model-hec-ras) and MIKE+ (platform-dhi-mike-plus) are comparable hydraulic modelling packages.
